# Fixtures whose *content* is not reproducible, one "<basename><TAB>reason" per
# line.  They are generated by test-data.sh, and the tool that produces them is
# either randomised or thread-order dependent, so two runs differ in the scores
# themselves - not just in the timestamp (that is washed out for every fixture,
# see sha256_fixture() in manifest.py).
#
# The wrappers already say the same thing: every one of these is asserted with
# compare="sim_size" delta_frac="0.7", i.e. "about this big", never "this exact
# content".  manifest.py therefore fingerprints the *existence* of the fixture
# and not its bytes; a renamed, added or deleted fixture still moves the
# fingerprint.
Epifany_1_out.idXML	Epifany runs an EM over protein probabilities, run to run the scores move by ~0.1 (0.54 vs 0.68 for the same ProteinHit)
Epifany_4_out_singlerun.idXML	same EM, -algorithm:keep_unidentified_masses run of the same input
Epifany_4_out_singlerun_fdr.idXML	same EM, the FDR variant
OpenSwathWorkflow_threads4.tmp.featureXML	-threads 4: the feature order and the scores depend on the thread schedule
